keyFindings.description: A serving-port session whose registration tick falls back to core (a transient StreamID/Ensure error; the entry is written without Delivery while its consumer stays) and is sent an unreadable or unadvertised mode: Resolve returns Push with err nil, so the refusal records an attempt. The next tick restores consumer delivery at the consumer's original start, below the message; the relay finds followedTopicAttempted and holds for attemptCacheTTL (5 min), stalling later messages, then reports a second delivery_failed. Fourth path to the same stall (rounds 5, 6, 7): fix it on the relay side so a refusal record can never hold the relay, e.g. in followedTopicVerdict judge as if no attempt existed, ack a refusal already reported, hold only a message that would be taken. Test that must fail: copy TestAnUnreadableDeliveryModeToASessionWithNoEntryLeavesNoHoldForItsRelay, write SessionEntry{Port: 4096, MachineID, Host} (what a consumer-error tick writes) instead of deleting it, publish the bogus mode, register again, publish a later message: it must reach the port well inside attemptCacheTTL (deep review's scratch TestDR8CoreWindowRefusalHoldsRelay fails at 20 s).
